library_summary_es: La evidencia clínica es variable y suele ser específica de indicación; un mecanismo biológico no demuestra por sí solo un beneficio clínico.
review_requirements: Verify human trials and clinical effect sizes by indication
Check population, formulation, dose, timing and duration
Check contraindications, adverse effects, medication and supplement interactions
Check combined exposure and duplicate forms
Check special populations, unknown answers and review sign-off
